dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Visible 'O' and 'C' shaped structures along the mid-body display high-intensity, thin perimeters (2-4 pixels) that transition sharply from light-gray to a low-intensity dark-brown core. Several structures are elongated vertically into irregular ovals.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: A high spatial density of small, solid high-intensity pixel clusters is concentrated in the anterior neck region and lower-lateral flank, lacking internal tonal gradients and appearing as irregular specks.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three most prominent dorsal annuli form an obtuse triangle. A secondary linear alignment is formed by four high-intensity blobs located posterior to the head, running roughly parallel to the dorsal curvature.
